hero.headline: Lock in your price before launch
hero.subheadline: Pre-order customers get lifetime early-bird pricing, priority access at launch, and a dedicated onboarding session. Offer ends December 31, 2026.

perks.title: Lifetime early-bird price
perks.description: Your pre-order rate is locked in forever — even as prices increase at launch.

perks.title: Priority access
perks.description: Be first in the door when we open the gates. No waiting in a general queue.

perks.title: Dedicated onboarding
perks.description: A 1-on-1 session with our team to get your first workflows running on day one.

perks.title: Shape the roadmap
perks.description: Pre-order customers get a direct line to the product team and vote on what we build next.
